title: First-mile quickstart landing — visual system and screenshot orchestration
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and produce a cohesive "first-mile" visual system for the Quickstart landing that unifies hero composition, step diagrams, and product screenshots. Deliver modular artwork and an export pipeline that enables the growth team and docs to ship localized landing pages with consistent assets. Focus on mobile-first layouts, three responsive breakpoints, accessible color/contrast tokens, and a lightweight animation system for micro-interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Hero artwork final in Figma with export-ready slices for 320/768/1280 widths
Three step-diagram variants: linear, stacked, and compact cards; each exported in PNG and SVG
Product screenshot set: desktop, tablet, and mobile compositions captured from staging with overlays applied; retina-ready (2x) exports
Animation spec (Lottie) for entrance micro-interaction and hover states documented with timeout and reduced-motion alternatives
Developer-ready asset pack uploaded to Drive + CDN path and a sample implementation snippet for the marketing React component
Contrast and accessibility audit completed and signed off by accessibility reviewer
Design handoff notes and QA checklist present in Confluence with visual diffs for staging vs final
